projects.title: MISSILE HEALTH
projects.subtitle: Enterprise Healthcare Management & Diagnostic Platform
projects.description: Full-stack healthcare management suite featuring electronic health records (EHR), real-time doctor appointment scheduling, prescription tracking, and AI-driven clinical symptom triage.

caseStudy.problem: Healthcare clinics suffered from queue bottlenecks due to fragmented legacy desktop record management systems.
caseStudy.solution: Built an asynchronous MERN web application using Redux Toolkit for complex UI state synchronization and Express REST controllers backed by MongoDB indexing.
architecture: React.js Single Page UI + Redux Store Slices
Express API Gateway + Helmet & Rate-Limiter Middleware
Mongoose Aggregation Pipeline for EHR Searching
JWT Token Authentication with HTTP-Only Cookie Storage
results: Reduced patient wait times by 65% across pilot clinics
Processed 20,000+ EHR queries with zero database connection pool exhaustion

projects.title: AI SYMPTOM CHECKER

caseStudy.problem: Patients lacked rapid, reliable guidance for classifying acute versus routine symptoms before seeking in-person care.
caseStudy.solution: Engineered an Express API integrating structured LLM evaluation prompts with strict Zod validation schemas.
results: Achieved 94% alignment with standard medical triage guidelines
Handled 500+ simultaneous evaluation requests without degradation
